characters.name: Atmaram
characters.personality: Determined, courageous, haunted by the past, inquisitive
characters.appearance: An elderly Indian man with a weathered, rugged look, deeply etched wrinkles from age and sorrow, and a lean yet sturdy frame suited for his age.
characters.face_features: Deep-set brown eyes reflecting shock and resolve, prominent cheekbones, sharp jawline covered by subtle stubble, intense and expressive gaze.
characters.hair: Short silver-white hair, neatly combed back with receding hairline, matching a neatly trimmed silver beard and mustache.
characters.clothing: Traditional layered Indian attire consisting of a loose cotton kurta, a dark vest over it, and loose trousers, often draped with a simple shawl for the cold nights.
characters.body_features: Lean build, slightly hunched with age but stands straight when determined, hands showing prominent veins and weathered knuckles.
characters.distinctive_features: A scar on his left hand from an old incident, piercing observant eyes, often seen carrying a wooden walking stick.
characters.visual_identity: Elderly Indian man, late 60s, silver-white hair, trimmed silver beard, deep wrinkles, traditional kurta and vest, intense and determined expression.
consistency_rules: Must always maintain silver-white hair and trimmed silver beard
Must wear traditional Indian kurta and vest combinations across all scenes
Facial wrinkles and deep-set eyes must remain consistent
Must look like a man in his late 60s with a lean and weathered frame

characters.name: Village Leader
characters.personality: Stern, authoritarian, manipulative, protective of dark secrets
characters.appearance: A commanding and intimidating middle-aged man with an imposing physical presence and authoritative demeanor.
characters.face_features: Stern expression, sharp piercing eyes, thick eyebrows, strong jawline, cold and calculating look.
characters.hair: Short salt-and-pepper hair, slicked back neatly, clean-shaven face with a sharp mustache.
characters.clothing: Traditional upper-class rural attire including a well-fitted white kurta-pyjama and a dark Nehru jacket, exuding power and status.
characters.body_features: Tall, broad-shouldered, upright posture reflecting dominance.
characters.distinctive_features: A commanding aura, sharp intimidating gaze, authoritative stance.
characters.visual_identity: Middle-aged Indian man, late 50s, salt-and-pepper hair, clean-shaven with mustache, white kurta-pyjama with dark Nehru jacket, stern and authoritative expression.
consistency_rules: Must always look stern and authoritative
Must wear traditional upper-class rural clothing like Nehru jackets
Must be visibly imposing compared to the protagonist
